
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/snapyust/p/19589256" title="发布于 2026-02-07 17:50">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">高中化学——物质组成分类转化</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="物质的组成与分类">物质的组成与分类</h1>
<h2 id="元素物质及微粒间的关系">元素、物质及微粒间的关系</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207163859329-1900629308.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\text{F,Na,Mg,Al}\)</span> 元素在自然界中没有游离态，<span class="math inline">\(\text{Si}\)</span> 为亲氧元素，在自然界中也没有游离态。<span class="math inline">\(\text{C}\)</span> 的游离态为金刚石，<span class="math inline">\(\text{Fe}\)</span> 的游离态为陨铁，<span class="math inline">\(\text{S}\)</span> 的游离态在火山口附近，稀有气体几乎都为游离态存在。</p>
<p>并非所有原子都有中子，如 <span class="math inline">\(^1_1\text{H}\)</span>。</p>
<p>常见同素异形体：金刚石&amp;石墨&amp;石墨烯，<span class="math inline">\(\text{O}_2\)</span>&amp;<span class="math inline">\(\text{O}_3\)</span>，红磷&amp;白磷&amp;黑磷。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207164802538-1097385759.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>宇宙中绝大部分物质都是等离子体。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207165130031-676959667.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207165337843-434542858.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207165545028-893784625.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>分散质例子直径：<span class="math inline">\(&lt;1\text{nm}\)</span> 为溶液，<span class="math inline">\(&gt;100\text{nm}\)</span> 为浊液，<span class="math inline">\(1-100\text{nm}\)</span> 为胶体。悬浊液：是固体小颗粒悬浮在液体里（如：泥水）。乳浊液：是液体小液滴分散在另一种液体里（如：牛奶）。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207170028273-52200369.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>极性键：不同元素之间。非极性键：同元素之间。</p>
<p>醋酸铅是弱电解质。有机化合物大多数为非电解质。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207170604790-314340012.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207170639397-1175625803.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\text{Mn}_2\text{O}_7\)</span> 为酸性氧化物。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207171242193-524858114.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>碱性氧化物一定是金属氧化物。</p>
<p>能与水反应的碱性氧化物生成的碱都是强碱。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207171634507-1380869895.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>具有两性的元素：哥（<span class="math inline">\(\text{Cr}\)</span>）心（<span class="math inline">\(\text{Zn}\)</span>）喜（<span class="math inline">\(\text{Sn}\)</span>）女（<span class="math inline">\(\text{Al}\)</span>）家（<span class="math inline">\(\text{Ga}\)</span>）钱（<span class="math inline">\(\text{Pb}\)</span>）币（<span class="math inline">\(\text{Be}\)</span>）。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207172710949-954268848.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207173112085-1011278964.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3014746/202602/3014746-20260207173239331-1609772962.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>硼酸和氢氧化铝的酸性来源不是水解。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\text{H}_3\text{BO}_3+\text{H}_2\text{O}\leftrightarrow\text{[B(OH)}_4\text{]}^-+\text{H}^+\)</span></p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\text{N}_2\text{H}_4+\text{H}_2\text{O}\leftrightarrow\text{N}_2\text{H}_5^++\text{OH}^-\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\text{N}_2\text{H}_5^++\text{H}_2\text{O}\leftrightarrow\text{N}_2\text{H}_6^{2+}+\text{OH}^-\)</span></p>


</div>
